title: habenaria montana
intro: Habenaria montana, commonly known as the Mountain Yellow Hibiscus, is a species of orchid native to the Himalayas. It has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including reducing inflammation and improving respiratory issues due to its expectorant properties. The therapeutic actions of Habenaria montana are attributed to its ability to stimulate coughing and relieve congestion, making it a traditional remedy for bronchitis and asthma. The bioactive constituents of Habenaria montana include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
